svg.text: Don't delete on read: an append-only log is fast and
Partitions = append-only logs read by offset
Leader + followers; acks=all to the ISR; Raft
Consumer groups commit offsets; retention or

In-memory queue: one machine, crash loses data, no replay.
"Each topic is partitioned into append-only logs
replicated to the in-sync replicas with acks=all;
consumers in a group split partitions and commit
offsets after processing, so they can resume,
replay, and other teams read the same data
